text: Osric didn't flee the village: he went down into the mine last night on his own, after writing NARIVYL on the wall. He is on the third level and he isn't coming to help; he's coming to repay what he has owed for thirty years.
keywords: Osric is on the third level
note: The table only knows that Osric vanished from his house (open thread from session 002). It is revealed when they find him down below or when the GM decides someone saw him go down; always with a secret_revealed.
